error[ZBX-E0305]: a scope with this container's name already exists
  while  starting container web-1
  while  starting the container's scope zbx-web-1.scope
  cause  systemd answered org.freedesktop.systemd1.UnitExists: Unit already
         exists
  scope  zbx-web-1.scope
  name   web-1
  rootfs /srv/alpine
  step   start_scope (6 of 49)
  fix    choose another name:      zbx run --name <other-name> ...
         or stop the other unit:   systemctl --user stop zbx-web-1.scope
  more   zbx explain E0305
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0305.html
